svg.data-asic: Broadcom Qumran2c+ BCM88840 with a Broadcom OP2 BCM16K external TCAM
svg.data-tcam: TCAM option available to meet diverse deployment requirements (datasheet)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover performance, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 with an additional licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC, Class C timing accuracy; NOS integration is required to activate any of it
svg.data-macsec: MACsec supported on all ports (datasheet key benefits)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400G QSFP-DD SR/LR/ER/ZR/OpenZR+, up to 600 km (HIG port table, ports 40-45)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G QSFP28 SR/LR/ER/ZR/OpenZR+, up to 80 km; 40G (HIG port table, ports 0-39)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR; 10G SFP+ SR/LR, up to 40 km (HIG port table, ports 46-49)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: NOT STATED. The four SFP+ management ports are named '4 x 10G SFP+ management ports' by the datasheet and '4x SFP+ Management' by HIG Figure 4, and the HIG's Port Overview table - the only place that gives reach and supported optics per port - has no row for them at all. 10G SFP+ is the form factor and speed the vendor states; which reaches are qualified in them is recorded as a gap rather than assumed from the SFP28 row above
svg.data-sfp28-sharing: the four SFP28/SFP-DD ports are in-band port share with 100GE port 0 (datasheet)
svg.data-timing-cable: 50 ohm SMA coaxial with a 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS, 50 ohm SMB coaxial with a 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz, shielded RJ45 for ToD, shielded RJ48 for BITS (datasheet Compatible Timing Cable Types)
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS in on SMA, 10MHz in/out on SMB, 1PPS in/out on SMB, ToD in/out on RJ45, BITS in/out on RJ48
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console
svg.data-sfp-plus-management: 4x 10G SFP+ management ports, numbered 0-3 in their own run
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A

g.data-description: led-oob-left: the left lamp in the out-of-band jack's aperture, drawn BLUE in HIG Figure 8. THIS GUIDE TABLES IT NOWHERE and the colour differs from the S9600-56DX's green/amber pair, so no link/activity vocabulary is borrowed from that sibling - the lamp carries a plain on state in the colour the figure draws it. See the mgmt-jack-led-semantics gap; led-oob-right: the right lamp in the out-of-band jack's aperture. Same unsourced state and the same gap as led-oob-left
g.title: oob

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYNC row - Off (system timing/clock synchronization is disabled or in free-run mode), Solid Green (timing core synchronized to PTP packet (Phase) or one of the external timing sources (Phase) and frequency locked), Blinking Green (synchronized to PTP packet (Frequency) or one of the external timing sources (Frequency)), Solid Yellow (acquiring state or holdover mode), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail or acquiring/holdover time out). Five rows: this table is longer than the S9600-56DX's three-row SYNC block and is transcribed as it stands
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (Host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but Host CPU/BMC boot failed)
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, FAN row - Off (fans are not initialized), Solid Green (all FAN modules working normally), Blinking Amber (FAN fail: one or more FAN modules need service). The blink on the fault state is this guide's, not the S9600-56DX's solid amber
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS0 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 working normally), Solid Amber (PSU0 fail, PSU0 needs service)
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS1 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 working normally), Solid Amber (PSU1 fail, PSU1 needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, ID row - Off (no power), Solid Blue (Reserved), Blinking Blue (beacon feature enabled). Solid Blue is carried because the table prints it, even though the vendor names no meaning for it
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: the 2x2 SFP28/SFP-DD quad, ports 46-49 of the single 0-49 run the HIG's Port Overview table numbers, in-band port share with 100GE port 0
g.title: port-46

g.data-description: the 2x2 SFP28/SFP-DD quad, ports 46-49 of the single 0-49 run the HIG's Port Overview table numbers, in-band port share with 100GE port 0
g.title: port-47

g.title: port-48

g.data-description: the 2x2 SFP28/SFP-DD quad, ports 46-49 of the single 0-49 run the HIG's Port Overview table numbers, in-band port share with 100GE port 0
g.title: port-49

g.data-description: the 2x2 quad below the SFP28 block, the datasheet's '4 x 10G SFP+ management ports' and HIG Figure 4's '4x SFP+ Management' callout. The vendor numbers them 0 to 3 in a run of their own, which collides with QSFP28 ports 0-3, so the ids here are mgmt-sfp-N and rel-pos keeps the printed number
